title: AI vibed some awesome camera tracking in my fitness game
author: LowZealousideal1045
selftext: I’ve been working on a mobile fitness RPG called [Stillbreaker](http://stillbreaker.com). Just amazing how well Claude has been able to get the camera detection! It’s been a lot of fun and good exercise. Would anybody want to play a game like this? Looking also for advice and ideas on good moves that you think the camera could detect. Anybody want to try the beta?

comments.author: FoodTimely8137
comments.body:
This is such a creative use of AI tooling and pose tracking! Combining a mobile fitness RPG with a camera detection system like Google's MediaPipe is an awesome idea.
​I really like how you used different models for specific tasks—having Claude orchestrate while leveraging other tools for visuals, voice acting, and internal tooling (like the move lab and map editor) sounds like a super efficient workflow. Plus, getting some good exercise out of your own development process is a huge win!
